bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are prohibited. The venue FAQ does not set out a size limit or clear-bag rule for other bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is available across Woodland Street at Fireman’s Credit Union from 6 p.m. to 3 a.m.; legal street spaces are on McFerrin Avenue and Ninth Street South. East Station parking is prohibited and subject to towing.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Basement East FAQ and directions pages do not designate a rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Rotating food trucks are stationed outside Lowbar below the venue. Outside food and drink are prohibited, except the venue FAQ explicitly allows Chivanada.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue says it is accessible and can provide a chair for medical needs when contacted before a show. Most shows are standing room with limited table seating sold separately.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Basement East FAQ does not state a rule for leaving and re-entering a ticketed concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are available online or at the Basement East box office Tuesday–Thursday noon–4 p.m. The venue FAQ does not describe will-call pickup.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The venue checks photo identification when required by the event and lists age restrictions on each show. The concert listing supplies the specific door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
